payload.body_you: {{holder1}} has the password, the information, the money, or the final say. You are expected to trust a decision you had very little part in making. The more unequal the arrangement feels, the harder it becomes to treat the disagreement like a small one.
payload.body_they: You have more information, access, money, or control over what happens next. {{holder1}} notices. What looks like stubbornness can be anger about an arrangement where one person keeps having more power than the other.
